summary: This update covers improvements and bug fixes for GitHub secret scanning. Update to audit log events On November 12, 2026 , the business field in affected secret_scanning_alert.* and secret_scanning_push_protection.bypass audit log events will change from the enterprise display name to the enterprise slug .
takeaways: To avoid disruption to any automated workflows, you should update integrations that filter by display name before rollout to accept both formats or use business_id instead.

Base64-encoded GitHub tokens: In private and internal repositories on github.com with secret scanning enabled, the existing revocation action (public preview) now supports encoded personal access tokens (classic), fine-grained personal access tokens, OAuth access tokens, and GitHub App user access tokens.
